propositions: Reconciler core modules pass transport parameters with no type annotation or with Any, preventing mypy from enforcing that backend implementations declare required members, enabling silent incompleteness like rebar:a357

Absolute imports via the sys.path-injected rebar_reconciler shim cause mypy to widen annotated port types to Any when ignore_missing_imports=true, so annotating alone does not enforce unless the port is imported relatively and resolved to the real rebar._engine.rebar_reconciler._backend type

Four call sites reach capability members (add_comment, set_relationship) unconditionally without narrowing the annotation, which mypy correctly flags but the existing AST audit cannot detect because metaclass attributes make hasattr return True

The custom metaclass _TransportPortMeta is necessary for runtime isinstance correctness in assert_transport_conforms and is orthogonal to static type checking; static enforcement requires relative port imports, not metaclass removal

Sixteen parameter defaults to None trigger [assignment] errors when typed as TicketTransport without Optional union, requiring annotation as TicketTransport|None to match actual guard patterns in function bodies

Both self-neutralizing defeat routes—annotating as Any and annotating with the unresolvable shim import path—must be guarded by an AST check that fails if any core reconciler client/transport parameter uses either form
